remarks: Experience the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and charm in this beautifully refreshed 1-bedroom condo at the historic Clocktower Close! Located on the main level, this unit features freshly painted interiors, a fully renovated bathroom, and a brand-new A/C unit to keep you comfortable year-round. Enjoy the ease of one-level living while taking advantage of the community's amenities, including a serene garden area, a well-equipped gym, and a spacious community kitchen. Perfectly situated in the heart of Norwalk, this condo offers easy access to major highways, public transportation, and a variety of restaurants, shops, and entertainment. Whether you're a first-time buyer or looking for an investment opportunity, this move-in-ready unit is ready to welcome you home. Schedule your showing today and make it yours before the new year!
